title: What if my chart has no fire?
old_caption: Counted your chart and found an element missing? It doesn't mean something is broken. Skills can be learned, and you don't need a partner to complete you. You arrive whole.

title: How does each mode handle a fight?
old_caption: Do you always just agree to end the argument? A good disagreement needs three moves: bring it up kindly, hold on to your values and stay flexible on the details. Save this for the next hard talk.

title: What is the winter solstice?
old_caption: Dark by late afternoon? The solstice is the longest night of the year in the north, and the light comes back a little every day after it. On long nights, reach out to the people who warm you.

title: Why do same-element signs make a triangle?
old_caption: Same-element signs sit 120 degrees apart on the wheel, which is why they form triangles. Easy connection feels lovely, but the people who aren't like you often help you grow the most.

title: What does Sagittarius season feel like?
old_caption: Sagittarius season runs until the December solstice, and astrologers read it as big questions and blunt honesty. The kindest truth still comes with a blanket: be honest, and be gentle about it.

title: What does Capricorn season feel like?
old_caption: Capricorn season starts on the longest night of the year up north. In astrology it's plans, patience and the slow climb. In love, the glow-up is simple: keep the small promises.

title: What does Aquarius season feel like?
old_caption: Yes, the water bearer is an air sign. Aquarius season is about friends, ideas and doing it your own way. Needing space isn't a warning sign; just say what you need, and ask what they need too.

title: What does Pisces season feel like?
old_caption: Pisces season, the last stop before the March equinox, and our teacher cried the whole lesson. Big feelings are a strength. Feel them fully, then check in with yourself before you share them.

title: What does Aries season feel like?
old_caption: Aries season begins at the March equinox: fresh starts and the courage to go first. Saying how you feel first is brave. Then leave real room for their answer, whatever it is.

title: What does Taurus season feel like?
old_caption: Taurus season is comfort, the senses and taking your time. If you feel behind because you like a slow pace, you're not. The small rituals you repeat together are how closeness gets built.
